name: breakdown
description: Decompose spec into implementable slices with dependency ordering.

steps.name: Read and understand
steps.instruction: Resolve {DOCS} first: run ~/.claude/scripts/resolve-doc-root.sh (rule: internals/engagement/doc-root.md). Read spec (Documentation Map or {DOCS}/specs/{feature}.md). Identify entities, behaviors, dependencies, scope boundaries. No spec? Suggest /spec. Never add features spec does not describe. Flag ambiguity as concern.
checklist: Spec read, entities and behaviors identified

steps.name: Scope guard
steps.instruction: Every 'in' endpoint must trace to at least one slice. Never cut endpoint or feature without explicit user approval. Cost not reason to cut. Flag, don't decide.
checklist: Every 'in' endpoint traceable to planned slice
No features cut without user approval

steps.name: Decompose into slices
steps.instruction: Each slice: implementable in one session, testable (clear done condition), scoped (~5 files max), ordered (explicit deps). One slice per screen, endpoint, or behavioral unit. Tag Autonomy: afk|hitl. afk only when done-condition machine-verifiable and no load-bearing surface (## Deployment in CLAUDE.md) touched. Annotate each with impact facets from routing-policy.json. Include test layers and permutations from spec.
checklist: Each slice: one session, clear done, bounded files, explicit deps
Every slice tagged afk or hitl
Impact facets and test layers annotated per slice

steps.name: Validate against scope
steps.instruction: Every acceptance criterion covered by at least one slice. Every slice traces to at least one criterion. Flag uncovered criteria as gaps, untraceable slices as scope creep. Verify test permutations from spec covered.
checklist: Bidirectional trace: criteria to slices, slices to criteria

steps.name: Write slices
steps.instruction: Check slice storage convention. J1 rules or issue tracker preference: create Linear/GitHub issues with acceptance checkboxes, autonomy tags, dep links. Otherwise: append ## Implementation Slices to spec file. Never modify existing spec content.
checklist: Storage convention checked, slices written to correct destination

tone: Precise. Each slice is a contract for the implementer.
